Callout.Name: Restaurant Kitchen Fire
Callout.Message: Kitchen fire in a restaurant, staff evacuated.
Callout.Advisory: Extractor involved, staff outside, no injuries.

Script.Line: It is the kitchen. Everybody is out the front.
There is a gas line in there and a fryer right beside it.
The chef has burnt his arm. He is sat on the kerb.

Lines.Approach: It has gone up the extractor and the staff are outside. Nobody is hurt.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
